reverted_attempt.branch: fix/image-vision-handoff (worktree removed, branch deleted, never committed)
reverted_attempt.what_it_did: (1) authorized <temp>/aionui as an image-read root in get_image_base64 (removed 403); (2) eagerly inlined each image as a base64 data: image_url ContentBlock for vision-capable models in build_content_blocks.
reverted_attempt.why_rejected: Part (2) is wrong: eagerly inlining full base64 images into message content blows up the conversation context/token budget — base64 inflates ~33%, and images persisted in conversation history get re-sent every turn. User rejected it.
reverted_attempt.correction: IMPORTANT: earlier claim of a lazy 'ViewImage' tool is FALSE. Verified by reading source: aionrs has NO ViewImage tool; the Read tool returns '(binary file, N bytes)' for images. The ONLY mechanism by which an image reaches the model is a base64 ContentBlock::Image { image_url } block — confirmed serialized by v0.2.6 providers (anthropic_shared, openai_messages, openai_responses_projector). So the reverted attempt used the CORRECT API; its only flaws were (a) unbounded image size and (b) the image block persisting in re-sent conversation history. The aioncore comment 'aionrs's ViewImage tool loads on demand' is stale/incorrect.
reverted_attempt.version_skew: aioncore ships aionrs v0.2.6 (has ContentBlock::Image). aionrs main refactored ContentBlock::Image away (main providers no longer reference it). A fix must target the shipped v0.2.6 mechanism and account for this skew.
reverted_attempt.correct_fix_pending_decision: Emit ContentBlock::Image ONLY for vision-capable models AND bound the cost: (1) downscale/re-encode the image to a small cap (e.g. max ~1024px / ~1MB) before base64; (2) do NOT keep the base64 image block in re-sent history — attach it only on the turn the image is uploaded (persist the text path in history, expand to an image block only for the current message) or strip old image blocks during compaction. Needs a product decision on size caps + history strategy before implementing.

root_cause_summary: AionUi hands uploaded/pasted images to models as a per-conversation OS temp-dir file path (…/Temp/aionui/<convId>/image-N.png) outside the agent workspace/sandbox, instead of embedding them as multimodal vision content. Two stacked failures: (1) custom providers have capability_count:0 so image_input_capability resolves 'Unknown' and no vision block is embedded; (2) the temp path is outside the sandbox, so /api/fs/image-base64 returns 403 PATH_OUTSIDE_SANDBOX and even ACP backends (codex/claude-code) cannot read pixels. Model receives only a text path -> hallucination or 'cannot read image'.
evidence: 3M4 app2.1.37 Kimi-K2.7-Code custom (capability_count:0), log image_input_capability:'Unknown', 403 PATH_OUTSIDE_SANDBOX, model self-admits only received path text. 3M5 codex 18x 403 PATH_OUTSIDE_SANDBOX. 3P8 app2.1.39 claude opus (vision-capable) still wrong description; macOS no 403 but image reached agent as tool target not vision block. All providers capability_count:0.

aioncore: crates/aionui-file/src/routes.rs:137,433 + service.rs:1019 get_image_base64 (sandbox extra_root -> PATH_OUTSIDE_SANDBOX, routes.rs:785 test)
crates/aionui-ai-agent/src/manager/aionrs/content.rs:9 ViewImage loads image only when a vision-capable model requests

fix_direction: Redo with the lazy approach: fix only image REACHABILITY (authorize the temp image dir as a read root, or store uploads inside the agent workspace) so the existing ViewImage lazy-load tool can read the image on demand — no eager base64 inlining, no history bloat. Separately consider surfacing the per-model image_input capability setting in UI/docs (3P8 was vision-capable opus but provider capability_count:0), and downscaling/size-capping images.
